what: the Black Knight, a proud living human knight who guards a little stone bridge and will let nobody cross: a tall, broad-shouldered man standing on two legs in a full suit of glossy jet-black enamelled plate armour, with nothing of him showing. His head is entirely inside a black closed great helm with a flat top and one narrow horizontal eye slit; the slit is plain dark shadow with no light in it. Every black plate has a bright pale steel-white worn edge that catches the light, so each plate is plainly seen: helm, big round shoulder plates, arm plates, elbow cops, gauntlets, thigh plates, knee cops and greaves. Over the breastplate hangs a plain black cloth surcoat to his knees, belted with a black leather belt. He has realistic adult proportions: a small head, wide shoulders, long limbs, about eight heads tall.
colours: glossy jet-black enamelled steel plate armour with bright pale steel-white worn edges on every plate, a plain black cloth surcoat, a black leather belt, a sword with a broad bright steel blade and a black hilt, a plain black shield with a broad pale steel-white dented rim.
wears: He wears a full suit of glossy black plate armour from head to foot, every plate edged in worn bright steel: a flat-topped closed great helm with one narrow eye slit and nothing on top of it, round shoulder plates, arm plates, gauntlets, thigh plates, knee cops and greaves. Over the breastplate hangs a plain knee-length black cloth surcoat with no emblem on it, belted at the waist. He has no cape.
holds: He holds exactly one broad straight sword in his right hand, with a bright steel blade, a straight black crossguard and a black grip. On his left arm he carries exactly one shield, flat at the top and pointed at the bottom: a plain sheet of black iron with a broad pale steel-white dented rim and nothing on its face but scratches.
pose: Seen from the front and a little from the side, facing a little to the left: he stands his ground with his feet planted wide apart, knees bent, both legs plainly separate with a clear gap between them; his right arm is raised high with the sword lifted above his helm, ready to bring it down; his left arm holds the black shield out in front of his body at chest height, a little to the side so his breastplate still shows. Exactly two arms and two legs.
